stated_parameters.wavelengths_basis: The sample enables three wavelengths in air (0.4861, 0.5876 and 0.6563 um, d and F and C); each is converted once to the vacuum wavelength the engine evaluates. The committed Project traces the primary 587.6 nm sample; the other two are recorded because the sample enables them and the doublet is corrected over that band.
stated_parameters.back_focus_basis: The sample's last surface spacing: its own paraxial solve places the image plane at the rear focus, so that spacing is the back focal distance from the final vertex.

sections.aperture_basis: The sample states no clear semi-diameters. Each element is given one clear diameter: the largest of the paraxial marginal-ray and chief-ray envelopes over its own surfaces (marginal ray through the stated entrance pupil, chief ray at the field points the sample enables), times a 2 per cent mechanical margin. The envelope is a minimum clear aperture, so every surface of the element passes the axial beam and the chief ray at the full stated field. It is a buildable estimate, not a drawing: no vignetting beyond the stop is modelled and no vignetting figure is claimed.
sections.transcription_notes: The sample states an image-space f-number of 8 and no focal length; the fields run to 1 deg. The record carries the engine's focal length and marks the paraxial comparison as not checkable.
